June 15, 2018 - By Kurt Siggers
Carlson Capital Management decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 20.72% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Carlson Capital Management sold 1,892 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 7,241 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.22M, down from 9,133 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Carlson Capital Management who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $930.29 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.80% or $1.53 during the last trading session, reaching $189.27. About 26.08 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
